name: Yokubou no Rougoku
source:
Protagonist Yuzuki Kyousuke, an orphan living alone, worked at an SME trading company as an office worker. He discovered the head of his department was committing fraud and intended to use this knowledge to his benefit to rise up in the ranks and further his career. Just when he is about to put his scheme into practice, a subordinate woman office worker tells on him and the head of department responds by using Kyousuke's line manager to wrongly pin responsibility onto Kyousuke, ultimately he loses his job in one of the most horrific ways: A disciplinary dismissal.

Now in his mid-30s, his job-hunting is going nowhere, he's behind on rent and has unpaid public utility bills and his credit card is blocked. All these circumstances add to him leading a very hopeless and despairing life that make him contemplate suicide.

"Just why... Why did this all had to happen...?"

As he continuously ponders those thoughts, his despair turns into regret and said regret turns into fury.

I hate everything! All right, I'll kill myself. But I won't just die. First, I'm going to humiliate those who put me into this misery, those who flaunt their delightful lives in front of my face, much more than I've been ever humiliated before! 

As a solution to his despair; his hatred focuses on three women...

- the CEO's daughter, Nirasawa Asuka,
- the section head's wife, Toishi Ryouko,
- and lastly, that woman who told on him, Hiyama Midori.

His final actions will be to abduct, rape and utterly denigrate them before ending his life.

Kyousuke's laugh of madness reverberates through the dark room as he discovers the disturbing solution to the end of his despair.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.sp-janis.com/puzzlebox/yokubounorougoku/index.html#story]Official website[/url]]
translation:
主人公汤筑恭介是一名孤儿，独自生活，在一家中小型贸易公司担任职员。他发现部门主管正在实施欺诈，打算利用这项发现为自己谋利，借此升职、推进事业。正要实施计划时，一名下属女职员揭发了他；部门主管则让恭介的直属上司把责任错误地推给他。最终，他以最糟糕的方式失去工作：遭到惩戒解雇。

年过三十的他求职毫无进展，房租逾期、水电费未缴、信用卡也被冻结。种种处境让他过着毫无希望、绝望透顶的生活，甚至开始考虑自杀。

“为什么……为什么这一切偏偏要发生在我身上……？”

当他不断思索这些问题，绝望转为悔恨，悔恨又转为愤怒。

我恨这一切！好吧，我会自杀。但我不会就这样死去。在那之前，我要羞辱那些让我陷入这般境地的人，羞辱那些在我面前炫耀愉快生活的人，要比我曾遭受的羞辱更加彻底！

作为绝望的解法，他的仇恨集中在三名女性身上……

- 社长的女儿韮山明日香；
- 课长的妻子砥石亮子；
- 最后，是揭发他的那个女人，桧山碧。

结束生命前，他最后的行动将是绑架、强奸并彻底践踏她们。

恭介发现了结束绝望的骇人方案，疯狂的笑声在黑暗房间中回荡。

[根据[url=http://www.sp-janis.com/puzzlebox/yokubounorougoku/index.html#story]官方网站[/url]的介绍翻译]
